idle.action: The exact warrior faces right, both feet planted and both hands holding the same low diagonal greatsword. One subtle breathing cycle: ready, inhale, exhale, settle. Keep head and equipment stable.

walk.action: One complete natural grounded walk-in-place cycle, always facing right. Both hands continuously grip the same greatsword in a low diagonal guard. NEAR means viewer-side leg, FAR means rear leg. In reading order: 1 NEAR heel forward/right contacts, FAR toe trails; 2 weight settles on NEAR leg with slight knee bend, FAR foot begins lifting; 3 FAR knee bends forward and FAR boot clearly lifts past grounded NEAR leg; 4 body rises slightly, FAR heel reaches forward/right, NEAR toe pushes off; 5 FAR heel forward/right contacts, NEAR toe trails; 6 weight settles on FAR leg with knee bend, NEAR foot lifts; 7 NEAR knee bends forward and NEAR boot lifts past grounded FAR leg; 8 body rises slightly, NEAR heel reaches forward/right and FAR toe pushes off, flowing to frame 1. At least one foot grounded throughout. Preserve fixed leg lengths, complete boots, stable head size and same grip. Show actual knee bending and heel/toe articulation, not standing poses with shifted feet. No run, jump, floating or wide-legged squat. Keep torso centered; the game supplies travel. No extra characters or effects.

attack.action: The exact warrior faces right and performs one two-handed greatsword attack: ready low guard, short upper-left windup with both hands together, clear diagonal slash toward right, low-right follow-through, recovery to waist, original ready guard. Same straight blade length and shape, feet grounded, no fist attack, no duplicate weapon, no slash trail or effect.
